text_block_list.text:
I find Кинг Хало grumbling about
something when
I walk into the cafeteria.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Urk... I simply cannot gain any more
weight!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
In order to maintain my first-rate beauty,
I need
to refrain from eating sweets for
the time being...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Well... I was thinking about
going on
a diet.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After all, physique is really important for
an
Umamusume. Don't you agree?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We need to be strong and limber in
races, yet
also elegant and light on our
feet at winning
concerts.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
To be first-rate, I must enchant everyone
with my
performance both on the stage
and on the track.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So, as my trainer, please give me your
full
support!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll need you to accompany me on my
early
morning runs, track my calorie
intake for me,
and...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll need your careful discretion every
day to
maintain my first-rate beauty!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And so, I work with Кинг Хало to help
her stay in
peak condition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
